default/31042.htm.text: Melody Maestro Kantabilon: Pleased to meet you! I am Melody Maestro Kantabilon! I specialize in putting music into small gems known as echo crystals. Music lovers from throughout the kingdom have been bringing me their scores for years. If you like, I will make a crystal for you! It will only cost …

links.text: [Create an Echo Crystal - Theme of Solitude]
[Create an Echo Crystal - Theme of the Feast]

Q00241_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul1/31042-0.text: Kantabilon: I can't believe somebody still knows about the song! Yes, I have a crystal like that. It's my most cherished possession, but I will gladly give it to someone who appreciates it's value! There is one problem that must be solved first, otherwise taking the crystal won't help you.
Kantabilon: I need the claws of Malruk Succubi to mend this Echo Crystal. I can't repair it without the proper tools. Go to the Dragon Valley to get the claws for me. I need at least 10 of them.
Kantabilon: These are perfect. I'll start working on it right away. It shouldn't take very long.
Kantabilon: Take the Echo Crystal and go back to your poet friend.

Q00431_WeddingMarch/31042-01.htm.text: Melody Maestro Kantabilon: Great news! I found the musical score for a wedding march I've been searching for! Now I can play for all the lucky couples in the world! I need a special Echo Crystal to store this music. Bring me 50 Silver Crystals, and I'll fill half of them with music for you!

Q00431_WeddingMarch/31042-00.htm.text: Melody Maestro Kantabilon: Your pitch is way off! (This quest can only be undertaken by a character of level 38 or above.)

Q00431_WeddingMarch/31042-03.html.text: Melody Maestro Kantabilon: How can you call yourself an Adventurer if you can't even get these crystals?

Q00431_WeddingMarch/31042-04.html.text: Melody Maestro Kantabilon: Oh, I'm so thrilled! Now I can share this blessed music at wedding ceremonies!

Q00241_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul1/31042-0.text: Kantabilon: The Echo Crystal is a fragile object and is easily broken. This one is worn out after so many years, and needs to be restored. It's delicate work requiring specialized tools. I'll need the long and sturdy claws of Malruk succubi from the Dragon Valley. Bring me ten sharp claws. Make sur…

Kantabilon: Now it will make the proper sound! Take it to Talien, your poet friend. I don't need you to reimburse me. I'd rather see the crystal being used for a worthy purpose than sitting in this dusty warehouse. Now hurry!

Q00431_WeddingMarch/31042-02.htm.text: Melody Maestro Kantabilon: According to the contract, you must bring me 50 Silver Crystals currently held by the Lienriks near Heine .

Q00431_WeddingMarch/31042-05.html.text: Melody Maestro Kantabilon: What can you gain by deceiving me? Go get the crystals!

Q00431_WeddingMarch/31042-06.html.text: Melody Maestro Kantabilon: Here are the Echo Crystals with the wedding march. May this music bless you someday!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-01.htm.text: Kantabilon: What soothing music! Ideal for a traveler such as yourself... Here is your crystal! Enjoy!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-02.htm.text: Kantabilon: Hi there! If you want an Echo Crystal, it'll cost you 200 adena.

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-03.htm.text: Kantabilon: How do you expect me to make a crystal if you don't bring me a score?

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-04.htm.text: Kantabilon: Oh, how noble! It brings to mind thousands of orcs marching bravely off to war... Your crystal is complete! Enjoy it!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-05.htm.text: Kantabilon: If you want me to create an Echo Crystal, it'll cost you 200 adena.

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-06.htm.text: Kantabilon: As you are well aware, I cannot make an Echo Crystal for you if you don't bring me a score! A fellow once told me that he was able to obtain an old score by talking to a fake alchemist in Oren...

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-07.htm.text: Kantabilon: Oh, how romantic! And melancholy at the same time... Like love, wouldn't you agree? Yes, this definitely has an Elven quality to it... Perhaps I should add a female Elven voice to the crystal?~ It is complete. Enjoy!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-08.htm.text: Kantabilon: Well, if you want an Echo Crystal it will cost you 200 adena.

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-09.htm.text: Kantabilon: I already told you that I cannot make an Echo Crystal for you if you don't bring me a score! A fellow once told me that he was able to obtain an old score by talking to a fake alchemist in Oren...

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-10.htm.text: Kantabilon: How sad! It reminds me of the feeling I get when I'm drinking alone on a rainy night... My, oh my, am I blue! Here is your crystal. Enjoy it!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-11.htm.text: Kantabilon: If you want an Echo Crystal it'll cost you 200 adena.

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-12.htm.text: Kantabilon: How do you expect me to make a crystal if you don't bring me a score?

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-13.htm.text: Kantabilon: This music makes me want to get up and dance! I haven't felt this good in years! All it needs is an accordion! Your crystal is complete. Enjoy it!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-14.htm.text: Kantabilon: If you want me to create an Echo Crystal it'll cost you 200 adena.

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-15.htm.text: Kantabilon: How do you expect me to make an Echo Crystal if you don't bring me a score?

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-16.htm.text: Melody Maestro Kantabilon: This is such a happy tune! I especially like the last part! It reminds me of watching a clown at the circus... It's done! Enjoy!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31042-17.htm.text: Melody Maestro Kantabilon: Hmm...! Is there a happy occasion in the offing? My, what heartwarming music! It's done! Enjoy!
